description: Noise floor on the actual tip, required by the H1.1.3 rule because E031's margin is +0.21 pp (< 0.3). Rerun E031 (commit 3797e1a) unchanged, once. Pool it with E031, and use E028 and E034 for context, to estimate the run-to-run sd of a 3-seed mean on the Muon line, where per-trial same-seed nondeterminism was up to 0.9 pp under SGD. Report per-seed accuracy and time.
